section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study investigating the relationship between semantic distance values and story-writing total scores. It found that cued semantic distance values significantly predicted story-writing total scores (ß = .31, p < .001) and explained unique variance (ΔR2 = .09) after controlling for word counts, indicating that participants generating more semantically distant responses in the cued condition also produced more creative stories. The analysis involved a sample size of 171 participants.
